AdjustmentReason.description: Reason code for an inventory adjustment line (WMS_ORD_TP=301). Required on every adjustment item.

BatchSplit.description: A portion of a line item fulfilled from one specific batch. Used when a single delivery line is split across multiple batches (e.g. partial FIFO fulfilment).

DimensionUnit.description: Unit of measure for linear dimensions used in HU DIMENSIONS objects.

DimensionUnit.title: DimensionUnit

HandlingUnit.description: A physical handling unit (pallet, box, container) assigned to a document item. Demonstrates three levels of nesting: HandlingUnit → DIMENSIONS (nested object) + ITEMS (array of HuItem dicts).
HandlingUnit.title: HandlingUnit

HuDimensions.description: Physical outer dimensions of a handling unit. All values in the unit specified by UNIT field.
HuDimensions.title: HuDimensions

HuItem.description: A single material line packed inside a handling unit. Represents the physical packing detail — what material, which batch, how many, and optionally the serial number.
HuItem.title: HuItem

HuType.description: Handling unit type. PAL=euro pallet, BOX=carton box, BAG=bulk bag, CTN=ISO container, PLT=flat pallet, TRL=trailer load.
HuType.title: HuType

InspectionCharResult.description: Result of evaluating a single quality inspection characteristic. NA=not applicable for this material, PENDING=awaiting lab result.
InspectionCharResult.title: InspectionCharResult

InspectionCharacteristic.description: A single quality characteristic evaluated during goods receipt inspection. Attribute checks (visual, label) use RESULT only; quantitative checks (weight, temperature) also carry NUMERIC_VALUE and LOWER/UPPER limits.
InspectionCharacteristic.title: InspectionCharacteristic

QualityDecision.description: Quality usage decision code attached to an inspection lot. A=Accept (unrestricted stock), R=Reject (returns to vendor or scrap), P=Partial accept (split stock), N=Not yet decided (inspection still open).
QualityDecision.title: QualityDecision

QualityInspection.description: Quality inspection block attached to a document item. Present only for Q-inspection managed materials. Contains the inspection lot reference, usage decision, and an array of evaluated characteristics (each an InspectionCharacteristic dict).
QualityInspection.title: QualityInspection

WeightUnit.description: Unit of measure for weight fields (GROSS_WEIGHT, TARE_WEIGHT).
WeightUnit.title: WeightUnit

DocItem.description: A single WMS document line item. Open schema (no additionalProperties:false) — SAP custom Z-fields and extension fields are common and must not be rejected by schema drift. Nested fields: BATCH_SPLITS (array of dicts), HANDLING_UNITS (array of dicts with nested DIMENSIONS + ITEMS), QUALITY_INSPECTION (object with CHARACTERISTICS array), SERIAL_NUMBERS (array of strings), CUSTOM_FIELDS (dict).

WmsOrderType.description: WMS order type code (WMS_ORD_TP). Determines which DOC_HEADER payload schema branch fires in Layer 2. 101=inbound transfer, 201=outbound transfer, 301=inventory adjustment, 401=vendor return, 501=cross-dock. Extend this enum when new order types are onboarded — requires only a business-types update, not a firewall change.
